delaylama_receipt.scope: Automatic original-source field evidence candidates for execution events; strict repeated quote recovery; current-source/event binding and compact evidence UI. Not a claim of complete contract accuracy.
observations: Normal extraction stores the original in document, so source selection must fall back from citation_document. The skipped initial runs are retained.
C141/C142 wired passes produced field evidence but expense/duration attribution remained incomplete. Their raw checks are retained.
Fresh C143 kept EUR1700 actual expense and two-day actual delay separate from EUR6200 requested payment and seven granted completion days.
Initial C143 used invented ellipses and incomplete actor/date impact premises; strict source validation withheld support.
One recheck after explicit contiguous-quote and per-impact premise instructions returned source-bound expense and duration candidates. Some cause and source-reference checks remain incomplete.
A separate deliberate EUR6200/7-day occurrence proposal was contradicted against actual expense/delay source premises in one six-field batch; saved outputs remained unchanged.

Claim Desk, evidence review and analysis-graph inspector expose the same field candidates with exact matches, bounded own-document excerpts and expandable details. No human feedback was accepted automatically.
The native graph still contains duplicate access-block candidates and an invoice-issuance candidate unsupported as issuance by its action sentence. These remain retained for qualification.
remaining: Synthetic English development draws are not independent legal gold, held-out/repeated-seed, causal or exhaustive long-document evaluations.
Graph neighborhood retrieval and exact text matching do not prove relationship meaning, complete extraction or entitlement.
Native occurrence/entity duplication, action-versus-documentation classification, source recall, procedure/applicability and payment reconciliation remain open.
Each populated material field is checked; unknown or omitted fields are not discovered by this pass. Financial-record stage candidates are not independently rechecked here.
Bounded input and eight-field output batches may omit information; transport/parse failures and missing premises remain insufficient. Additional calls add latency/cost; no measured speed gain.
Earlier primary-quote warnings and nested historical metadata remain separately visible; no raw history was rewritten.
No new Go implementation, LayaGo/GLiNER/MLX training, architecture or weights.
delaylama_receipt.graph_projection_policy: Field checks remain application review metadata. They do not write native relations, change amounts/durations, sum related records or accept human reviews.
delaylama_receipt.export_policy: Vectors/embeddings omitted; intermediate failures and raw proposals retained; configured credential-value scan passed.
